name: Aquatop Submersible Glass Aquarium Heater
Description: Keep your aquarium at just the right temperature with the Aquatop Submersible Glass Aquarium Heater. Made of high-quality insulated glass, it’s the easy way to maintain the temperature your freshwater or marine aquariums need to keep your plants and critters healthy. The analog design makes it simple to use with just the turn of a knob to adjust the temperature to your needs, and it features a highly visible temperature setting to make monitoring the temperature easy, with no guesswork. Plus, it’s easy to set up with included suction cups, and is available from 50 to 300-watts for tanks of various sizes.

name: OneTigris Cotton Canvas Dog Backpack
Description: **Remember to measure your pet for the paw-fect fit.** The OneTigris Cotton Canvas Medium & Large Dog Backpack lets you get into the wild with your adventurous pup. These sleek, stylish saddlebags are made from heavy-duty cotton canvas that’s lightweight and durable with a vintage look. There are a variety of storage options for all the food, water and supplies she’ll need for the day including large zippered pouches on each side that feature a small zippered inner pocket for keys, money or other small items, as well as outer pockets that are held closed with fuzzy fastener straps for quick and easy access. The fully adjustable neck strap and dual chest and belly straps with quick-release buckles provide a snug, secure and comfortable fit.

name: Frisco Circle Design Stainless Steel Dog & Cat Bowl
Description: It’s always a positive when our pets are excited to eat, and it doesn’t get more enticing than this pawsome circle design stainless-steel bowl. Think of it as pulling out the fancy cutlery for those special dinner dates, except this fancy bowl will be around all the time! Time to clean up? The stainless-steel bowl can be removed from the melamine base whenever things get dirty. It’s also top-rack dishwasher safe, making cleanup an absolute breeze.

name: Prevue Pet Products Tinkle Turf System for Dogs
Description: Prevue Pet Products Tinkle Turf System for Dogs provides a convenient option for your pup to relieve themselves when getting outdoors isn’t an easy option. The synthetic grass square tray will help protect your floors and furniture, plus it’s also an ideal training tool for young pups that can be easily transported when traveling with your pet. The lead-free tray is also protected with microbial odor control.  It’s a soft and realistic turf that’s easy to clean with warm water and dish soap then rinse and let air dry.  It works well with small and larger dogs, too.

name: Aquascape Fountain Scale Free Water Treatment, 8-oz bottle
Description: Help your finned friends breathe easily with the Aquascape Fountain Scale Free Fish WaterTreatment! This water treatment effectively eradicates hard water deposits, white scale and foam and helps keep your water clean and clear. Use regularly to prevent damage and clogging of pumps and plumbing. It features an enticing lavender smell, and it contains no chemicals or acids. It’s non-toxic, so it’s safe to use to keep your scaly sidekicks happy and healthy!

name: 904 Custom Personalized My Cat & I Funny Double Sided Mug, 11-oz
Description: Celebrate your furry family member and show everyone just how much you love her with this paw-some 904 Custom Personalized My Cat & I Funny Double Sided Mug! This ceramic coffee mug is proudly made in the USA and can hold 11 oz. of your favorite coffee, tea, or other beverage of choice. Not only is it completely microwave and dishwasher safe for your convenience, but you can also have it personalized with custom text. This mug makes a great gift for fellow pet parents!

name: IRIS USA Open Top Cat Litter Box w/Scatter Shield
Description: The IRIS USA Open Top Cat Litter Box with Scatter Shield & Scoop features extra-tall walls to help contain litter and spray while keeping dirt out. The open top provides quick and easy access, while the deep design gives your cat a semi-private space to take care of business. Recessed bottoms and molded-in feet help keep the cat litter box in place, and the molded-in rims around the pan add extra strength and stability. Plus, the high-polished interior surfaces and included litter scoop make this litter box easy to clean!

name: Hyper Pet Flippy Flopper Flying Disc Dog Toy, Color Varies, 9-in
Description: Help your dog spend his boundless reserves of energy with the Hyper Pet Flippy Flopper Flying Disc. This interactive toss and fetch toy will provide hours of playtime for you and your furry friend. Made from soft rubber and nylon, the toy measures nine inches in diameter and comes in a variety of colors. It’s safe for your pal’s teeth and durable enough to withstand daily play sessions. The flying dog toy acts like a frisbee and floats in water, plus it complies with children’s toy standards, so you can feel safe about letting your kids have fun with it too. Choose from a 1-pack, 2-pack or 5-pack!

name: Underwater Treasures Bubble Disk Aquarium Pump
Description: Provide live-sustaining oxygen to your underwater pals with the Bubble Disk Aquarium Pump from Underwater Treasure! Simply pop in this aquarium pump and watch as oxygen-rich bubbles provide ample energy for your active fish. The size and output of your air pump can establish how large a portion of the disk will discharge these air bubbles. Plus, it is easily cleanable — just rinse the bubble disk in clear water to remove dust.

name: Wild One Dog Poop Bags, 120 count
Description: Take care of business after your dog takes care of his with Wild One Dog Poop Bags. These unscented bags are made with a corn starch blend, which makes them extra thick and leak proof to help contain the mess inside where it belongs. Each purchase comes with 120 blush-colored bags (12 rolls total)!

name: Scratch and Peck Feeds Naturally Free Organic Starter Chicken & Duck Feed
Description: Give your growing chicks and ducklings the nutrition and taste they need to thrive with the Scratch and Peck Naturally Free Organic Starter Chicken Food. Formulated with organic, raw whole grains like wheat and barley, plus nutrient-rich meals like sesame, flax and kelp, it’s a complete and balanced feed for starting poultry chicks and ducklings. Naturally free of soy, corn or fillers, it packs more nutrition in every peck—like omegas, vitamins, minerals, probiotics and essential amino acids. Plus, it’s sourced and made in the USA with never any GMO foods.

name: Hartz Cattraction Silver Vine & Catnip Plush Macaron Mice Cat Toy, 2 count
Description: Entice your pretty kitty to play with Cattraction Silver Vine & Catnip Plush Macaron Mice Cat Toys from Hartz. This pair of plush pastry macaron mice come in pastel colors with jingly bells and expressive features to intrigue your furry friend. They are filled with a potent combination of silver vine and catnip attractants to grab your paw-tner’s attention and enhance her playtime. These toys are also light enough for your companion to carry, swat and bat for hours of enjoyment. Hartz Cattraction Silver Vine & Catnip Plush Macaron Mice Cat Toys stimulate your sidekick’s natural instincts to fulfill her need to play.

name: Farm Innovators Drain Plug De-Icer
Description: Say goodbye to frozen stock tanks this winter with the Farm Innovators Drain Plug De-Icer. This de-icer delivers 1500 watts of power and can be used in all Rubbermaid stock tanks with drain holes (sold separately). It’s designed to fit through the drain plug hole for easy installation, and is unnoticeable to livestock. This submersible de-icer is suitable for tanks up to 300 gallons. It’s thermostatically controlled to operate only when the water temperature reaches 35 degrees or less, saving you electricity.

name: Frisco Fashion Bow, Striped
Description: The perfect everyday look for your pup or kitty starts with a bow tie. And actually, that’s all you need! It’s a statement piece, it’s easy to wear, it brings out their best features, it’s a little dressed-up moment to make any day special. Simply put it on with an elastic band and your pet will be ready to rock the look to impress that playdate or just look cute for the fun of it.

name: Aquapaw Pro Dog Grooming Tool, Blue
Description: Bath time has never been easier than with the Aquapaw Pro Dog Grooming Tool. It combines a silicone sprayer and a scrubber in one convenient tool, so you can rinse and brush your furry friend’s coat at the same time! The sprayer-scrubber features a 2-stage button mechanism that you can click to Low, High and ON and Off with one hand. It gives you total control over your pet and the flow of water during the entire bathing process, eliminating much of the time and fuss involved in bath time. This particular tool was designed with larger dogs and thicker coats in mind to help save time, reduce mess and eliminate the stress of bath time for you and your pet!

name: Tomlyn Pill-Masker Bacon Flavored Paste for Cats
Description: Streamline pill time with Tomlyn Pill-Masker Bacon Flavored Paste for Cats! This shapeable paste is perfect for wrapping around pills of any size to conceal those necessary medications. The feline-focused formula with bacon flavor helps make pills delicious, so you can help keep your kitty healthy and happy. Plus this paste is moist and juicy, to match other cat foods. With this paste, your cat won’t have such a big pill to swallow.

name: Frisco "Classic #2" Photos White Personalized Coffee Mug
Description: We know your pet is your cup of tea—and now you can show off their adorable personality with every sip. This ceramic mug is customizable with your pet’s photo and a unique phrase—for you or for your favorite pet parent friend. “Who’s that cute kitty or doggy?” everyone will ask when you’re sipping your coffee. Whatever beverage you start your day with, you’re sure to start some conversation with this one-of-a-kind mug.

name: Purina Beneful Medleys Tuscan Style Canned Dog Food
Description: Dazzle your dog at mealtime with Purina Beneful Medleys Tuscan Style Canned Dog Food. Real beef delivers meaty goodness in every bite, and the 100% complete and balanced nutrition offered in each can helps support his overall health and well-being. Real carrots, rice and spinach offer added flavor to the recipe blend in the form of ingredients you can see, and the small, tender chunks of meat create an appealing texture he's sure to wag his tail for. Essential vitamins and minerals give this delectable entree the nutrients your dog needs for his whole-body health and wellness, making you feel good about the meal you serve him every day. This tasty recipe is crafted without artificial colors, flavors or preservatives. Show him how much you care about his health and happiness with a bowlful of this handy single-serving deliciousness.

name: Vitakraft Vita Smart Gourmet Fortified Daily Cockatiel & Lovebird Food, 4-lb bag
Description: The Vitakraft Vita Smart Gourmet Cockatiel and Lovebird Food is designed specifically for your Cockatiel or Lovebird, and is packed full of good stuff to keep your feathered friend flap-happy. This premium grain, fruit and nut seed mix delivers complete nutrition. With ingredients including millet, sunflower seeds, nutriberries, peas, papaya, carrots, coconut and pineapple, it’s like a super tasty fiesta in a bag. Unique ingredients like dried chamomile and dried rose hips help ensure your bird will never be bored. Aloe vera concentrate and other nutrients support your bird’s skin health.

name: Penn-Plax Turtle Topper Above Tank Basking Platform
Description: The Penn-Plax Turtle Topper Above Tank Basking Platform provides a unique spot for turtles to bask on top of their tank. Aquatic turtles are naturally avid swimmers that prefer deep water. Because the Turtle Topper sits on top, you can fill the tank completely so your turtle can enjoy swimming throughout the entire tank. It’s made to support the weight of multiple or larger turtles without sinking, which helps keep them dry as they bask. Two mounting rims are included to attach clamp lamps for optimal basking.

name: Pet Factory Twistedz 3 to 3.5-inch Beefhide Mini Rolls Beef Flavored Dog Hard Chews, 14 count
Description: Put a tasty twist on snacktime with Pet Factory Twistedz 3 to 3.5-inch Beefhide Mini Rolls Beef Flavored Dog Hard Chews! These two-in-one treats combine real meat and American beefhide to create a flavorful, natural chew that dogs find hard to resist! Twistedz mini rolls are the paw-fect choice for avid chewers. Each beefy bite is 99% digestible and contains no harmful additives or preservatives. With paw-rental supervision, these chews offer a tasty, fun and satisfying workout for your dog’s wild instincts!

name: B&G Martin Faux Leather Poly Fill Cushion Insert Dog & Cat Bed
Description: Your furbaby deserves to be pampered and the B&G Martin Faux Leather Poly Fill Cushion Insert Dog & Cat Bed makes that su-paw easy. This pet bed is 100% vegan and cruelty-free, paw-fect for any animal lover and their best friend. The faux leather cover provides a luxurious feel and fits into most home décor––it will beautifully complement other leather furniture in your home. A polyfill cushion insert helps to keep your furbaby comfortable while catching some Z’s. Just wipe down the bed for easy cleaning.

name: Turbo Krinkle Balls Cat Toy, 4 count
Description: Treat your furbaby to hours of play and exercise with Turbo Assorted Ball Cat Toys! Your kitty will love the way this ball bounces, rolls and twirls. Each Krinkle Ball is made with a shiny, crinkly material to help capture your kitty’s attention. This fun feline toy makes the purr-fect addition to your cat’s rotating collection. Plus, it encourages active play, mental stimulation and paw-sitive bonding between you and your furry friend!

name: Ice Horse Horse Knee Wrap
Description: The Ice Horse Horse Knee Wrap provides targeted therapeutic cooling to your horse’s knee. This wrap surrounds the entire knee joint to reduce heat and swelling. It includes reusable Cold Capsule inserts that help it stay cold longer. Specially placed Velcro closures create a secure and tight fit, and technical fabric keeps the Cold Capsules compressed and in place. An included suspender strap also helps to keep the wraps secure. When you’re done, just put the inserts back in the freezer to use them again.

name: Simplicity 200 Micron Plastic Ring Aquarium Filter Sock
Description: A quality filter sock is an integral part of keeping your aquarium water clean, healthy and free of debris. Fitting the Simplicity 200 Micron Plastic Ring Aquarium Filter Sock on your filter (sold separately) means you know your fishy friends will swim in the cleanest, healthiest water possible. Made in the US from durable material that will last, this aquarium accessory comes in a variety of sizes and styles to fit your tank’s needs.

name: Friskies Tasty Treasures Pate Liver & Beef Wet Cat Food
Description: Friskies Tasty Treasures Pate Beef & Liver Dinner Canned Cat Food is like a treasure find for your kitty’s taste buds! This whisker-licking recipe features real beef, and is packed with everything your cat needs to fuel all those furry adventures - like protein, antioxidants and healthy omegas. The formula is also enhanced with vitamins, minerals and essential taurine for nose-to-tail well-being in every bite. Plus, it provides moisture to help keep your pal hydrated and support urinary health. So open up the easy pull tab and turn mealtime into yum time.

name: Purina Pro Plan Focus Adult Urinary Tract Health Formula with Salmon Classic Canned Cat Food
Description: Nourish kitty with the foods she adores and the focused nutrition she needs when you serve Pro Plan Urinary Tract Health Formula Classic Entree With Salmon Adult Wet Cat Food. This adult cat food helps keep up your kitty's urinary tract health by reducing urinary pH and providing low dietary magnesium. Plus, every tender bite is chock full of kitty-approved flavor. Purposeful ingredients like real salmon are blended in, and along with that high-quality protein, your feline friend gets 25 essential vitamins and minerals plus taurine, an amino acid. Best of all, this highly digestible pate cat food promotes optimal nutrient delivery, helping the high-quality ingredients go to work to support her nose-to-tail well-being. Your furry companion is one-of-a-kind. Care for her unique needs with focused nutrition when you try this urinary cat food risk free.

name: NaturVet All-In-One Support Soft Chews Dog Supplement, 120 count + NaturVet Senior Care Hip & Joint Advanced Formula Dog Soft Chews, 120 count
Description: Support your sweet senior’s joints and overall health with NaturVet All-In-One Support Soft Chews Dog Supplement and NaturVet Senior Care Hip & Joint Advanced Formula Dog Soft Chews. Both supplements are formulated to support healthy hip and joint function including cartilage and connective tissues. All-in-One Support chews cover your pup’s essential health needs including digestive enzymes to help support proper digestion and a healthy digestive tract. They contain glucosamine and chondroitin for added joint support in dogs plus omega-3, -6 and -9 fatty acids for healthy skin and a glossy coat. Senior Care chews are veterinarian formulated and recommended to support healthy hips and joints. Safe for use with dogs aged 1 year and older.

name: Sublime Adjustable Dog Collar
Description: **Remember to measure your pet for the paw-fect fit.** Your pup will be the bark of the town wearing the fetching Sublime Adjustable Dog Collar! It features a double-sided design with two complementary patterns for twice the possibilities, and twice the fun. It also includes an extra-wide width and stylish, durable plastic hardware. This collar is sure to keep your barking bestie looking fur-esh and fashionable all year long!

name: Decker Manufacturing Company Union Fiber Horse Brush
Description: Keep your stallion looking sharp with the Decker Manufacturing Company Union Fiber Horse Brush. This medium-stiff brush features 1.38-inch union fiber bristles, which are ideal for removing dust, dirt and debris from his neck, body and legs. The Grip-Fit® handle is designed to fit comfortably in your hand while the nylon hand strap provides maximum control without slipping. And since it’s made from durable polypropylene, it won’t rot or mildew. Like all Decker equine products, this brush is proudly made in the USA.

name: Mighty Tequila Worm Squeaky Stuffing-Free Plush Dog Toy
Description: This Mighty Tequila Worm is the paw-fect toy for dogs who like to play a little “ruff”. This plush toy is reinforced with multiple layers of durable materials and several layers of stitching that’s flipped inside for added strength. It’s also made with zero stuffing—just squeaker balls! That means you don’t have to worry about any fluffy disasters spread across your floors, furniture or yard. It's great for fetching and tugging and it makes an excellent companion to accompany your pup during a game of toss and catch.  Once your long day of play is done, simply place your BFF’s new pal in the washing machine for easy cleaning.

name: Ware Living Room Series Ferret Cage
Description: Enjoy comfort, safety and convenient cleaning with the Ware Living Room Series Ferret Cage. This cozy cage comes complete with shelves, ramps, a bowl and other accessories to help your fuzzy friend feel right at home. It’s made with durable plastic, powder-coated metal and chew-proof welded steel. Narrow 1-inch bar spacing helps prevent your adventurous fellow from sneaking out. Plus, the full size slide-out pan makes cleanups a breeze!

name: Shapley's Magic Sheen Horse Hair Polish
Description: Shapley's Magic Sheen Horse Hair Polish was voted by Horse Journal as the “Top Choice” of all silicone hair polish on the market. It gives the coat an exceptional shine, helps reduce hair loss and repels dirt and stains. Magic Sheen protects the hair shaft and keeps mane and tail hair tangle-free to minimize damage and breakage from brushing. This special formula won’t strip away moisture or natural oils, so it’s safe for everyday use.
